native_bindings.role: memory observations and contextual style candidates

understanding.principle: Recall an observation together with its context, original interpretation and limits. Reconsider its relevance and possible meaning under current evidence. Remembering is not understanding; a changed interpretation is not automatically a new fact.

effects.MINUS: narrow or withdraw an unsupported inference, retain original provenance
effects.PLUS: add a newly supported or explicitly hypothetical relationship

understanding.contradictions: Preserve contrary evidence; distinguish genuine incompatibility from different circumstances. Unsupported claims stay candidate or HOLD. No automatic global promotion.

possibility.selection: Current track meaning and creative intent determine whether to use, combine, reinterpret, leave dormant or invent a candidate possibility. No numeric rank, fixed card count, forced rotation or word-to-sound lookup as authority.
possibility.emergence: A combination may suggest a new possibility absent from any individual card. Record as hypothesis until supported; do not assert audio effect from reasoning.

theory.protect: R05 Dark Psychedelic, R06 maximum clean club mastering and cross-track diversity, R07 context isolation, deliberate creator intent, intelligibility and mixability

persistence: Use existing native memory and evidence relations conceptually; preserve original records and retain scope; no autonomous writes or model-weight claims
implementation: GPT-native additive contract; existing Python engine unchanged
